title: Private Niagara Falls Premium Driving Tour
includes: Admission to Niagara City Cruises Boat Cruise (Included in Price)
Seasonal: Boat Cruise (May - December) (Replaced by Niagara Takes Flight)
Luxury Transportation in a Mercedes Metris Van
Completely Private VIP Driving Tour of Niagara Falls
Admission to Journey Behind the Falls (Included in Price)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note the Voyage to the Falls boat is seasonal, operating May through December. Please phone ahead to check availability.
Kindly note: Niagara Takes Flight is not accessible to infants or children under 100 cm.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your private tour begins with a local guide greeting you at your downtown Niagara Falls hotel. First, you’ll visit the Skylon Tower, ascending 520 ft. in a glass elevator for breathtaking views of all three falls and the surrounding area.

Next, descend 125 ft. at Journey Behind the Falls to explore tunnels and observation decks that bring you up close to the falls’ power and beauty.

You'll then board the seasonal Voyage to the Falls boat (seasonal, May - December) to sail near the Falls, where you’ll feel the mist—rain ponchos provided! In winter, the boat ride is replaced by admission to Niagara Takes Flight.

End your tour with a narrated driving tour of Niagara’s highlights, including the Dufferin Islands, Whirlpool Rapids, and the Floral Clock.

Enjoy a comfortable return to your hotel in a Mercedes Metris van. Book your exclusive Niagara Falls tour today!
